{"background": {
    "type": "photographic",
    "id": "photo_base",
    "description": "一张连续的城市街道摄影底图，画面包含黄昏天空、电线杆、建筑立面和路面。中央的牛皮纸卡片遮挡了大部分区域，但画布四边均露出连续的街景环境，作为全画幅背景承载整体构图。"
},
"objects": [
    {
        "id": "overlay_clip_top",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            312,
            64,
            405,
            168
        ],
        "description": "位于顶部边缘的金属长尾夹，下半部分压在牛皮纸卡片上，上半部分露在卡片外。"
    },
    {
        "id": "overlay_clip_bottom",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            330,
            840,
            425,
            945
        ],
        "description": "位于底部边缘的金属长尾夹，上半部分压在牛皮纸卡片上，下半部分露在卡片外。"
    },
    {
        "id": "paper_card",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            117,
            126,
            905,
            880
        ],
        "description": "占据画面主体的矩形牛皮纸卡片，中间有一条横向的白色缝线装饰，将卡片分为上下两部分。所有照片和文字元素均附着在此卡片上。"
    },
    {
        "id": "overlay_label_summer",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            150,
            145,
            255,
            235
        ],
        "description": "左上角带有麻绳挂环的标签贴纸，上面印有“summer paradise”字样。"
    },
    {
        "id": "photo_sea",
        "kind": "photo",
        "bbox": [
            170,
            190,
            415,
            325
        ],
        "description": "显示蓝色海面与船舷栏杆的照片，右上角贴有一张写有“The throbbing of summer is a grand encounter”的小纸条。"
    },
    {
        "id": "overlay_starfish",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            135,
            295,
            225,
            350
        ],
        "description": "两枚白色海星图案贴纸，叠放在海面照片的左下角。"
    },
    {
        "id": "text_best_journey",
        "kind": "text",
        "bbox": [
            160,
            370,
            320,
            470
        ],
        "text": "The best\njourneyS Start\nwith a one-way\nticket in hand\nand no plan\nin mind",
        "color": "#2B2B2B",
        "font": "hand",
        "align": "left",
        "bold": false,
        "italic": false
    },
    {
        "id": "photo_writing",
        "kind": "photo",
        "bbox": [
            328,
            355,
            485,
            475
        ],
        "description": "显示人物正在桌前书写的照片，左侧被文字遮挡。"
    },
    {
        "id": "overlay_tag_little_things",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            450,
            340,
            510,
            365
        ],
        "description": "位于书写照片右上角的报纸风格小标签，印有“LITTLE THINGS make big days.”。"
    },
    {
        "id": "photo_bbq",
        "kind": "photo",
        "bbox": [
            525,
            185,
            830,
            355
        ],
        "description": "显示烤肉架和配菜碗的美食照片，左侧边缘有竖排文字“Dora:”。"
    },
    {
        "id": "overlay_note_focus",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            740,
            165,
            870,
            215
        ],
        "description": "右上角倾斜放置的白色便签纸，手写内容“focus on the good”。"
    },
    {
        "id": "overlay_happy_sun",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            670,
            365,
            850,
            415
        ],
        "description": "手绘风格的太阳图案及单词“Happy”，位于中部右侧。"
    },
    {
        "id": "text_children_day",
        "kind": "text",
        "bbox": [
            650,
            430,
            865,
            475
        ],
        "text": "Children's Day",
        "color": "#FFFFFF",
        "font": "hand",
        "align": "center",
        "bold": false,
        "italic": false
    },
    {
        "id": "frame_polaroid",
        "kind": "frame",
        "bbox": [
            170,
            540,
            470,
            820
        ],
        "description": "左下方的拍立得相纸框，底部留白处写有“Arrebol☆”。",
        "photo_id": [
            "photo_girl_field"
        ]
    },
    {
        "id": "photo_girl_field",
        "kind": "photo",
        "bbox": [
            188,
            565,
            450,
            755
        ],
        "description": "拍立得相纸内的照片，显示戴帽子的女孩站在草地石墙旁。"
    },
    {
        "id": "photo_girl_street",
        "kind": "photo",
        "bbox": [
            540,
            550,
            805,
            705
        ],
        "description": "右侧显示穿灰色背心女孩站在车旁的照片，头部被裁剪。"
    },
    {
        "id": "overlay_postcard_joy",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            745,
            525,
            875,
            595
        ],
        "description": "右上角的明信片样式贴纸，印有邮票框和手写体“joy has a habit of returning.”。"
    },
    {
        "id": "overlay_to_be_continued",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            720,
            685,
            875,
            715
        ],
        "description": "由三个独立小方块组成的装饰条，分别写着“To”、“be”、“continued”。"
    },
    {
        "id": "overlay_note_yellow",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            520,
            720,
            710,
            780
        ],
        "description": "黄色便签纸，上面有多行难以辨认的手写英文。"
    },
    {
        "id": "overlay_shaker",
        "kind": "overlay",
        "bbox": [
            760,
            720,
            860,
        785
        ],
        "description": "蓝色的沙锤或摇铃插画贴纸，周围有小星星点缀。"
    },
    {
        "id": "text_souvenir",
        "kind": "text",
        "bbox": [
            590,
            795,
            855,
            850
        ],
        "text": "The best Souvenir iS the\nperson you became while\nno one was watching",
        "color": "#2B2B2B",
        "font": "hand",
        "align": "right",
        "bold": false,
        "italic": false
    }
],
"layer_order": [
    "photo_base",
    "paper_card",
    "overlay_label_summer",
    "photo_sea",
    "overlay_starfish",
    "text_best_journey",
    "photo_writing",
    "overlay_tag_little_things",
    "photo_bbq",
    "overlay_note_focus",
    "overlay_happy_sun",
    "text_children_day",
    "frame_polaroid",
    "photo_girl_field",
    "photo_girl_street",
    "overlay_postcard_joy",
    "overlay_to_be_continued",
    "overlay_note_yellow",
    "overlay_shaker",
    "text_souvenir",
    "overlay_clip_top",
    "overlay_clip_bottom"
]
}
